The client-side script as an HTML dependency

Source: R/enable.R
snap_dependency.Rd

The snap_*() server functions inject this script into the page on first use, so including it in the UI is optional. Include it explicitly when you want the script to load with the page, before the server function runs.

Usage

snap_dependency()

Value

An htmltools::htmlDependency().

Examples

snap_dependency()
#> List of 10
#>  $ name      : chr "shinysnap"
#>  $ version   : chr "0.1.0"
#>  $ src       :List of 1
#>   ..$ file: chr "/home/runner/work/_temp/Library/shinysnap/www"
#>  $ meta      : NULL
#>  $ script    : chr "shinysnap.js"
#>  $ stylesheet: NULL
#>  $ head      : NULL
#>  $ attachment: NULL
#>  $ package   : NULL
#>  $ all_files : logi TRUE
#>  - attr(*, "class")= chr "html_dependency"
